fact: At a 24 October 2023 workshop the commune of Ouagadougou presented the updated urban addressing (pilot phase covering three arrondissements and Bobo-Dioulasso, over 93,000 doors and 16,000 streets addressed in Ouagadougou, two digital address-management platforms) and the gendarmerie, police and fire services each received the addressing plan of the arrondissements.
title: Communes urbaines : des acteurs s’approprient le nouveau plan d’adressage
